name: greenloop
description: Selran Greenloop — the loop that runs until green. Point it at any codebase and it maps the architecture, reconstructs the spec, audits against ten quality categories, fixes what it finds, and adversarially re-verifies — repeating until nothing is left to fix. Five skills: cartographer, spec-bootstrap, pre-commit-verification, app-audit, audit-fix. Free for personal, non-commercial use.
